verses.original: Τοιγαροῦν καὶ ἡμεῖς τοσοῦτον ἔχοντες περικείμενον ἡμῖν νέφος μαρτύρων ὄγκον ἀποθέμενοι πάντα καὶ τὴν εὐπερίστατον ἁμαρτίαν δι’ ὑπομονῆς τρέχωμεν τὸν προκείμενον ἡμῖν ἀγῶνα
verses.transliteration: Toigaroun kai hēmeis tosouton echontes perikeimenon hēmin nephos martyrōn onkon apothemenoi panta kai tēn euperistaton hamartian di’ hypomonēs trechōmen ton prokeimenon hēmin agōna
verses.literal: Therefore since we are surrounded by . . . such a great cloud of witnesses let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles and let us run with endurance the race set out for us
verses.literalPt: PORTANTO nós também, pois que estamos rodeados de uma tão grande nuvem de testemunhas, deixemos todo o embaraço, e o pecado que tão de perto nos rodeia, e corramos com paciência a carreira que nos está proposta,

verses.original: ἀφορῶντες εἰς τὸν τῆς πίστεως ἀρχηγὸν καὶ τελειωτὴν Ἰησοῦν ὃς ἀντὶ τῆς προκειμένης αὐτῷ χαρᾶς ὑπέμεινεν σταυρὸν αἰσχύνης καταφρονήσας ἐν δεξιᾷ τε τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ Θεοῦ κεκάθικεν
verses.transliteration: aphorōntes eis ton tēs pisteōs archēgon kai teleiōtēn Iēsoun hos anti tēs prokeimenēs autō charas hypemeinen stauron aischynēs kataphronēsas en dexia te tou thronou tou Theou kekathiken
verses.literal: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus the author and perfecter of our faith who for the joy set before Him endured the cross scorning its shame and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God
verses.literalPt: Olhando para Jesus, autor e consumador da fé, o qual, pelo gozo que lhe estava proposto, suportou a cruz, desprezando a afronta, e assentou-se à destra do trono de Deus.

verses.original: ἀναλογίσασθε γὰρ τὸν τοιαύτην ὑπομεμενηκότα ὑπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν εἰς ἑαυτὸν ἀντιλογίαν ἵνα μὴ κάμητε ταῖς ψυχαῖς ὑμῶν ἐκλυόμενοι
verses.transliteration: analogisasthe gar ton toiautēn hypomemenēkota hypo tōn hamartōlōn eis heauton antilogian hina mē kamēte tais psychais hymōn eklyomenoi
verses.literal: Consider Him who endured such hostility . . . . . . from sinners so that you will not grow weary and lose heart . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Considerai, pois, aquele que suportou tais contradições dos pecadores contra si mesmo, para que não enfraqueçais, desfalecendo em vossos ânimos.

verses.original: Οὔπω μέχρις αἵματος ἀντικατέστητε πρὸς τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἀνταγωνιζόμενοι
verses.transliteration: Oupō mechris haimatos antikatestēte pros tēn hamartian antagōnizomenoi
verses.literal: In your struggle against sin you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood
verses.literalPt: Ainda não resististes até ao sangue, combatendo contra o pecado.

verses.original: καὶ ἐκλέλησθε τῆς παρακλήσεως ἥτις ὑμῖν ὡς υἱοῖς διαλέγεται Υἱέ μου μὴ ὀλιγώρει παιδείας Κυρίου μηδὲ ἐκλύου ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐλεγχόμενος
verses.transliteration: kai eklelēsthe tēs paraklēseōs hētis hymin hōs huiois dialegetai Huie mou mē oligōrei paideias Kyriou mēde eklyou hyp’ autou elenchomenos
verses.literal: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons My son do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord and do not lose heart when He rebukes you
verses.literalPt: E já vos esquecestes da exortação que argumenta convosco como filhos: Filho meu, não desprezes a correção do SENHOR, E não desmaies quando por ele fores repreendido;

verses.original: ὃν γὰρ ἀγαπᾷ Κύριος παιδεύει μαστιγοῖ δὲ πάντα υἱὸν ὃν παραδέχεται
verses.transliteration: hon gar agapa Kyrios paideuei mastigoi de panta huion hon paradechetai
verses.literal: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves and He chastises every son . . . He receives
verses.literalPt: Porque o Senhor corrige o que ama, E açoita a qualquer que recebe por filho.

verses.original: Εἰς παιδείαν ὑπομένετε ὡς υἱοῖς ὑμῖν προσφέρεται ὁ Θεός τίς γὰρ υἱὸς ὃν οὐ παιδεύει πατήρ
verses.transliteration: Eis paideian hypomenete hōs huiois hymin prospheretai ho Theos tis gar huios hon ou paideuei patēr
verses.literal: Endure suffering as discipline God is treating you as sons For what son is not disciplined by his father
verses.literalPt: Se suportais a correção, Deus vos trata como filhos; porque, que filho há a quem o pai não corrija?

verses.original: εἰ δὲ χωρίς ἐστε παιδείας ἧς μέτοχοι γεγόνασιν πάντες ἄρα νόθοι καὶ οὐχ υἱοί ἐστε
verses.transliteration: ei de chōris este paideias hēs metochoi gegonasin pantes ara nothoi kai ouch huioi este
verses.literal: If you do not experience . . . discipline like everyone else then you are illegitimate children and not true sons
verses.literalPt: Mas, se estais sem disciplina, da qual todos são feitos participantes, sois então bastardos, e não filhos.

verses.original: εἶτα τοὺς μὲν τῆς σαρκὸς ἡμῶν πατέρας εἴχομεν παιδευτὰς καὶ ἐνετρεπόμεθα οὐ πολὺ δὲ μᾶλλον ὑποταγησόμεθα τῷ Πατρὶ τῶν πνευμάτων καὶ ζήσομεν
verses.transliteration: eita tous men tēs sarkos hēmōn pateras eichomen paideutas kai enetrepometha ou poly de mallon hypotagēsometha tō Patri tōn pneumatōn kai zēsomen
verses.literal: Furthermore . . . we have all had earthly fathers who disciplined us and we respected them Should we not much more . . . submit to the Father of our spirits and live
verses.literalPt: Além do que, tivemos nossos pais segundo a carne, para nos corrigirem, e nós os reverenciamos; não nos sujeitaremos muito mais ao Pai dos espíritos, para vivermos?

verses.original: Οἱ μὲν γὰρ πρὸς ὀλίγας ἡμέρας κατὰ τὸ δοκοῦν αὐτοῖς ἐπαίδευον ὁ δὲ ἐπὶ τὸ συμφέρον εἰς τὸ μεταλαβεῖν τῆς ἁγιότητος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hoi men gar pros oligas hēmeras kata to dokoun autois epaideuon ho de epi to sympheron eis to metalabein tēs hagiotētos autou
verses.literal: Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best but God disciplines us for our good so that we may share in His holiness
verses.literalPt: Porque aqueles, na verdade, por um pouco de tempo, nos corrigiam como bem lhes parecia; mas este, para nosso proveito, para sermos participantes da sua santidade.

verses.original: πᾶσα δὲ παιδεία πρὸς μὲν τὸ παρὸν οὐ δοκεῖ χαρᾶς εἶναι ἀλλὰ λύπης ὕστερον δὲ καρπὸν εἰρηνικὸν τοῖς δι’ αὐτῆς γεγυμνασμένοις ἀποδίδωσιν δικαιοσύνης
verses.transliteration: pasa de paideia pros men to paron ou dokei charas einai alla lypēs hysteron de karpon eirēnikon tois di’ autēs gegymnasmenois apodidōsin dikaiosynēs
verses.literal: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time but painful Later on however it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it
verses.literalPt: E, na verdade, toda a correção, ao presente, não parece ser de gozo, senão de tristeza, mas depois produz um fruto pacífico de justiça nos exercitados por ela.

verses.original: Διὸ τὰς παρειμένας χεῖρας καὶ τὰ παραλελυμένα γόνατα ἀνορθώσατε
verses.transliteration: Dio tas pareimenas cheiras kai ta paralelymena gonata anorthōsate
verses.literal: Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees
verses.literalPt: Portanto, tornai a levantar as mãos cansadas, e os joelhos desconjuntados,

verses.original: καὶ τροχιὰς ὀρθὰς ποιεῖτε τοῖς ποσὶν ὑμῶν ἵνα μὴ τὸ χωλὸν ἐκτραπῇ ἰαθῇ δὲ μᾶλλον
verses.transliteration: kai trochias orthas poieite tois posin hymōn hina mē to chōlon ektrapē iathē de mallon
verses.literal: Make straight paths for your feet so that the lame may not be disabled but rather healed
verses.literalPt: E fazei veredas direitas para os vossos pés, para que o que manqueja não se desvie inteiramente, antes seja sarado.

verses.original: Εἰρήνην διώκετε μετὰ πάντων καὶ τὸν ἁγιασμόν οὗ χωρὶς οὐδεὶς ὄψεται τὸν Κύριον
verses.transliteration: Eirēnēn diōkete meta pantōn kai ton hagiasmon hou chōris oudeis opsetai ton Kyrion
verses.literal: Pursue peace with everyone as well as holiness without which no one will see the Lord
verses.literalPt: Segui a paz com todos, e a santificação, sem a qual ninguém verá o Senhor;

verses.original: ἐπισκοποῦντες μή τις ὑστερῶν ἀπὸ τῆς χάριτος τοῦ Θεοῦ μή τις ῥίζα πικρίας ἄνω φύουσα ἐνοχλῇ καὶ δι’ αὐτῆς μιανθῶσιν οἱ πολλοί
verses.transliteration: episkopountes mē tis hysterōn apo tēs charitos tou Theou mē tis rhiza pikrias anō phyousa enochlē kai di’ autēs mianthōsin hoi polloi
verses.literal: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God and that no . . . root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and - defile many
verses.literalPt: Tendo cuidado de que ninguém se prive da graça de Deus, e de que nenhuma raiz de amargura, brotando, vos perturbe, e por ela muitos se contaminem.

verses.original: μή τις πόρνος ἢ βέβηλος ὡς Ἠσαῦ ὃς ἀντὶ βρώσεως μιᾶς ἀπέδετο τὰ πρωτοτόκια ἑαυτοῦ
verses.transliteration: mē tis pornos ē bebēlos hōs Ēsau hos anti brōseōs mias apedeto ta prōtotokia heautou
verses.literal: See to it that no one is sexually immoral or is godless like Esau who for a single meal sold his birthright
verses.literalPt: E ninguém seja devasso, ou profano, como Esaú, que por uma refeição vendeu o seu direito de primogenitura.

verses.original: ἴστε γὰρ ὅτι καὶ μετέπειτα θέλων κληρονομῆσαι τὴν εὐλογίαν ἀπεδοκιμάσθη μετανοίας γὰρ τόπον οὐχ εὗρεν καίπερ μετὰ δακρύων ἐκζητήσας αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: iste gar hoti kai metepeita thelōn klēronomēsai tēn eulogian apedokimasthē metanoias gar topon ouch heuren kaiper meta dakryōn ekzētēsas autēn
verses.literal: For you know that afterward when he wanted to inherit the blessing he was rejected He could find no ground for repentance though he sought the blessing with tears
verses.literalPt: Porque bem sabeis que, querendo ele ainda depois herdar a bênção, foi rejeitado, porque não achou lugar de arrependimento, ainda que com lágrimas o buscou.

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ προσεληλύθατε ψηλαφωμένῳ καὶ κεκαυμένῳ πυρὶ καὶ γνόφῳ καὶ ζόφῳ καὶ θυέλλῃ
verses.transliteration: Ou gar proselēlythate psēlaphōmenō kai kekaumenō pyri kai gnophō kai zophō kai thyellē
verses.literal: For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire to darkness gloom and storm
verses.literalPt: Porque não chegastes ao monte palpável, aceso em fogo, e à escuridão, e às trevas, e à tempestade,

verses.original: καὶ σάλπιγγος ἤχῳ καὶ φωνῇ ῥημάτων ἧς οἱ ἀκούσαντες παρῃτήσαντο μὴ προστεθῆναι αὐτοῖς λόγον
verses.transliteration: kai salpingos ēchō kai phōnē rhēmatōn hēs hoi akousantes parētēsanto mē prostethēnai autois logon
verses.literal: to a trumpet blast or to a voice . . . that made its hearers beg that no further word be spoken
verses.literalPt: E ao sonido da trombeta, e à voz das palavras, a qual os que a ouviram pediram que se lhes não falasse mais;

verses.original: οὐκ ἔφερον γὰρ τὸ διαστελλόμενον Κἂν θηρίον θίγῃ τοῦ ὄρους λιθοβοληθήσεται
verses.transliteration: ouk epheron gar to diastellomenon Kan thērion thigē tou orous lithobolēthēsetai
verses.literal: For they could not bear what was commanded If even an animal touches the mountain it must be stoned
verses.literalPt: Porque não podiam suportar o que se lhes mandava: Se até um animal tocar o monte será apedrejado ou passado com um dardo.

verses.original: καί οὕτω φοβερὸν ἦν τὸ φανταζόμενον Μωϋσῆς εἶπεν Ἔκφοβός εἰμι καὶ ἔντρομος
verses.transliteration: kai houtō phoberon ēn to phantazomenon Mōusēs eipen Ekphobos eimi kai entromos
verses.literal: The sight was so terrifying that even Moses said I am trembling with fear
verses.literalPt: E tão terrível era a visão, que Moisés disse: Estou todo assombrado, e tremendo.

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ προσεληλύθατε Σιὼν ὄρει καὶ πόλει Θεοῦ ζῶντος Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐπουρανίῳ καὶ μυριάσιν ἀγγέλων
verses.transliteration: Alla proselēlythate Siōn orei kai polei Theou zōntos Ierousalēm epouraniō kai myriasin angelōn
verses.literal: Instead you have come to Mount Zion to the city of the living God the heavenly Jerusalem You have come to myriads of angels
verses.literalPt: Mas chegastes ao monte Sião, e à cidade do Deus vivo, à Jerusalém celestial, e aos muitos milhares de anjos;

verses.original: πανηγύρει καὶ ἐκκλησίᾳ πρωτοτόκων ἀπογεγραμμένων ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ Κριτῇ Θεῷ πάντων καὶ πνεύμασι δικαίων τετελειωμένων
verses.transliteration: panēgyrei kai ekklēsia prōtotokōn apogegrammenōn en ouranois kai Kritē Theō pantōn kai pneumasi dikaiōn teteleiōmenōn
verses.literal: in joyful assembly to the congregation of the firstborn enrolled in heaven You have come to God the Judge of all to the spirits of the righteous made perfect
verses.literalPt: À universal assembléia e igreja dos primogênitos, que estão inscritos nos céus, e a Deus, o juiz de todos, e aos espíritos dos justos aperfeiçoados;

verses.original: καὶ διαθήκης νέας μεσίτῃ Ἰησοῦ καὶ αἵματι ῥαντισμοῦ κρεῖττον λαλοῦντι παρὰ τὸν Ἅβελ
verses.transliteration: kai diathēkēs neas mesitē Iēsou kai haimati rhantismou kreitton lalounti para ton Habel
verses.literal: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel
verses.literalPt: E a Jesus, o Mediador de uma nova aliança, e ao sangue da aspersão, que fala melhor do que o de Abel.

verses.original: Βλέπετε μὴ παραιτήσησθε τὸν λαλοῦντα εἰ γὰρ ἐκεῖνοι οὐκ ἐξέφυγον ἐπὶ γῆς παραιτησάμενοι τὸν χρηματίζοντα πολὺ μᾶλλον ἡμεῖς οἱ τὸν ἀπ’ οὐρανῶν ἀποστρεφόμενοι
verses.transliteration: Blepete mē paraitēsēsthe ton lalounta ei gar ekeinoi ouk exephygon epi gēs paraitēsamenoi ton chrēmatizonta poly mallon hēmeis hoi ton ap’ ouranōn apostrephomenoi
verses.literal: See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven
verses.literalPt: Vede que não rejeiteis ao que fala; porque, se não escaparam aqueles que rejeitaram o que na terra os advertia, muito menos nós, se nos desviarmos daquele que é dos céus;

verses.original: οὗ ἡ φωνὴ τὴν γῆν ἐσάλευσεν τότε νῦν δὲ ἐπήγγελται λέγων Ἔτι ἅπαξ ἐγὼ σείσω οὐ μόνον τὴν γῆν ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸν οὐρανόν
verses.transliteration: hou hē phōnē tēn gēn esaleusen tote nyn de epēngeltai legōn Eti hapax egō seisō ou monon tēn gēn alla kai ton ouranon
verses.literal: At that time His voice shook the earth but now He has promised Once more I will shake not only the earth but heaven as well
verses.literalPt: A voz do qual moveu então a terra, mas agora anunciou, dizendo: Ainda uma vez comoverei, não só a terra, senão também o céu.

verses.original: τὸ δὲ Ἔτι ἅπαξ δηλοῖ τὴν τῶν σαλευομένων μετάθεσιν ὡς πεποιημένων ἵνα μείνῃ τὰ μὴ σαλευόμενα
verses.transliteration: to de Eti hapax dēloi tēn tōn saleuomenōn metathesin hōs pepoiēmenōn hina meinē ta mē saleuomena
verses.literal: The words Once more signify the removal of what can be shaken that is created things so that the unshakable may remain
verses.literalPt: E esta palavra: Ainda uma vez, mostra a mudança das coisas móveis, como coisas feitas, para que as imóveis permaneçam.

verses.original: Διὸ βασιλείαν ἀσάλευτον παραλαμβάνοντες ἔχωμεν χάριν δι’ ἧς λατρεύωμεν εὐαρέστως τῷ Θεῷ μετὰ εὐλαβείας καὶ δέους
verses.transliteration: Dio basileian asaleuton paralambanontes echōmen charin di’ hēs latreuōmen euarestōs tō Theō meta eulabeias kai deous
verses.literal: Therefore since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom let us be filled with gratitude and so . . . worship God acceptably with reverence and awe
verses.literalPt: Por isso, tendo recebido um reino que não pode ser abalado, retenhamos a graça, pela qual sirvamos a Deus agradavelmente, com reverência e piedade;

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν πῦρ καταναλίσκον
verses.transliteration: kai gar ho Theos hēmōn pyr katanaliskon
verses.literal: For our God is a consuming fire
verses.literalPt: Porque o nosso Deus é um fogo consumidor.
